summary: Public projects created on 10 August 2026: 9 repos.
intro: Agent tooling and workflow documentation dominate: an index of end-to-end agentic workflows, a staged purchase evaluation pipeline, a shopping assistant demo, and traffic shaping for concurrent coding sessions. Policy and civic work appears through AI policymaking repositories and a fictional Jerusalem mayoral manifesto, alongside a documented case of ADHD medication access in Israel. Two utilities round it out: a virtual macropad and a zoxide alias bridge.

projects.name: Agent Reference Workflows
projects.description: Index of repositories that each demonstrate one agentic workflow end to end — kept as working context for designing plugins: what the workflow is, where it worked, and where it broke.

projects.name: Agentic Purchase Pipeline
projects.description: A staged, agent-supported process for evaluating any purchase over ~$50: capture the spec, find the requirement no vendor publishes, revise the spec as research lands, and decide on landed cost.

projects.name: AI Assisted Policymaking Index
projects.description: Index of repositories that use AI to formulate and explore public policy — manifestos, policy papers, multi-lens deliberation runs, and the research workspaces behind them.

projects.name: Claude Fleet Traffic Shaper
projects.description: Priority-aware traffic shaping for a fleet of concurrent Claude Code sessions — spec and prior-art research

projects.name: Claude For Mayor
projects.description: An AI-assisted municipal platform for a candidate who doesn't exist — a Jerusalem mayoral manifesto built properly: testimony, evidence, comparator cities, costed proposals, and a rule that nothing...

projects.name: Claude Shopping Eval Demo
projects.description: A demo of using Claude Code as a consumer purchasing assistant — spec + retailer catalogue screenshots in, ranked recommendations as a typeset PDF out.

projects.name: Israel ADHD Medication Access
projects.description: A documented, redacted case record of trying to obtain prescribed ADHD medication in Israel — the published rules, the referral loop, and the regulation nobody mentioned

projects.name: Virtual Macropad
projects.description: A software macropad for laptop users: press a leader key, a grid appears, press one more key, the macro fires.

projects.name: Zalias
projects.description: Bridge shell aliases and zoxide: name a directory whatever you actually call it, and let z find it. Aliases become real zoxide entries, so fuzzy matching and frecency apply to them too.
